Medical History

- Current health concerns and risk factors:
  - 2-month history of significant work-related anxiety since starting a new job; morning dread of leaving home.
  - Sleep disturbance: difficulty falling asleep, shallow sleep, early morning awakening with racing heart; estimates 3–4 hours/night.
  - Palpitations most mornings, perceived irregular, lasting minutes up to ~10 minutes; associated with panic; chest discomfort when heartbeat is fast. Chest pain denied but also described as “painful when heart is beating fast” (conflict noted).
  - Daytime low energy, anhedonia, social withdrawal.
  - Anxiety triggered by public transport (tube), heat/airlessness.
  - No prior similar episodes; no reported panic attacks to date.
  - Denies suicidal ideation; has supportive family. Lives with parents.

- Relevant family medical history:
  - Mother with a history of depression.

- Medications (including OTC or shared medications):
  - No regular medications mentioned; no OTC/shared meds documented.
  - Allergies: Not recorded.

  - Not recorded.

  - Not recorded.

- Physical activity and nutrition:
  - Previously ran and played tennis; currently reduced due to anxiety/low mood.
  - Eating regularly; appetite largely unchanged; increased chocolate intake.

- Alcohol, tobacco, and substance use:
  - Alcohol: Heavy intake on Fridays/Saturdays (reports exceeding limits); occasional glass of wine during the week; exact quantities not recorded.
  - Tobacco: Occasional smoking.
  - Illicit drugs: Denies.

- Hearing loss or concerns:
  - Not recorded.

- Mood/mental health (including depression, self-harm risk):
  - Persistent anxiety and low mood; anhedonia; on edge; work stress as main trigger.
  - Denies suicidal thoughts or self-harm; good family support.
  - Open to one-to-one therapy; no prior counseling.

- Vision problems or recent changes:
  - Not recorded.

Quality checks
- Missing expected elements: Past medical/surgical history; complete medication and allergy list; vital signs (BP, pulse, rhythm); BMI/waist; physical exam; urinalysis; immunization status; sexual and reproductive health history (including contraception and cervical screening status); quantified alcohol intake (standard drinks/week); smoking frequency/dependence; hearing and vision screening; cardiovascular/diabetes risk assessment; lipid/glucose screening.
- Internal contradictions: Chest pain both denied and implied (“painful when heart is beating fast”) during palpitations (conflict noted).
- Transcript quality: Several incomplete/unclear phrases; no objective measurements recorded.
